    rectangle "Group 1: (1$|x,)" {
      rectangle "Choice: (1$|x,)" {
        rectangle "Sequence: (1$|" {
          component """FinalSymbol(1)""" as node_AST_2
          component """AnchorNode($)""" as node_AST_3
        }
        component """Choice((1$|x,))""" as node_CHOICE_1 <<choice>>
        component """FinalSymbol(x,)""" as node_AST_4
      }
    }
    component """Repeat((1$|x,){0,1})""" as node_REPEAT_ENTRY_0 <<repeat>>
  }
  rectangle "Repeat: (2$|y,){0,1} 		 {0..1}" {
    rectangle "Group 2: (2$|y,)" {
      rectangle "Choice: (2$|y,)" {
        rectangle "Sequence: (2$|" {
          component """FinalSymbol(2)""" as node_AST_7
          component """AnchorNode($)""" as node_AST_8
        }
        component """Choice((2$|y,))""" as node_CHOICE_6 <<choice>>
        component """FinalSymbol(y,)""" as node_AST_9
      }
    }
    component """Repeat((2$|y,){0,1})""" as node_REPEAT_ENTRY_5 <<repeat>>
  }
}

node_AST_2 --> node_AST_3

node_CHOICE_1 --> node_AST_4
